description.value: The Fort St. James location of Four Rivers Co-op, a member-owned co-operative that is part of the Federated Co-operatives network serving communities across northern and central BC. As a full-service co-op, it offers food, home centre, agro, fuel, and propane services under one banner. For touring cyclists passing through Fort St. James, it represents a significant resupply point in a remote region of the Cariboo and Chilcotin interior.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a Federated Co-operatives supermarket at 250 East Stewart Street with postal code V0J 3A0 (Fort St. James, BC). The website confirms Four Rivers Co-op is a real, operating multi-location co-op that lists Food, Vending, Propane, and Fuel as distinct service categories, confirming basic groceries and vending machines; propane service supports a camping fuel claim. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'Co-op' but the corporate brand is 'Four Rivers Co-op'; the OSM name is acceptable shorthand but may cause confusion with other Co-op locations.
No phone number present in OSM tags or confirmed via website (multi-location site does not list per-store contact details on the fetched pages).
Website URL was system-discovered rather than sourced from an OSM tag; could not cross-check against an OSM-provided URL.
